brief: Reads a folder of agent files, gates each one, and mounts the accepted agents on a host so that dropping a file in the folder deploys it.
detail: A .pia file is data: it is judged by stzAgentDeclaration and turned into an agent. A .ring file is a program: the folder does not execute it, the application loads it, and the folder finds its <name>Agent() function and holds the object to the same four gates (it must answer Name_, Cycle, CoverageStatement and ReversibilityClass). A bad file does not stop the others: it is refused, kept in Refusals with the file that caused it, and ReadAgents counts only the accepted. Rescan compares a SHA-256 of each file, since a modification time is not available in this build. The folder does not watch the disk; whoever owns the cadence calls Rescan.
